privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This Privacy Policy explains what information Foghaven ("we", "the game") collects when you play, why we collect it, how long we keep it, and how you can have it deleted.

WHAT WE COLLECT

Account data: if you register, we store your email address, username, and a securely hashed version of your password (we never store your password itself). We also record whether you confirmed you are 13 or older and when you accepted these terms.

Gameplay data: match results, the role you played, tasks completed, survival time, and votes cast during a round are used to build your lifetime stats and to run the game itself. Cosmetic purchases and your in-game coin balance are also stored against your account.

Chat and moderation data: in-game chat is temporarily retained (30 days) so that player reports can be reviewed by moderators. If you file or are the subject of a report, the relevant chat excerpt, the report itself, and any resulting moderation action (mute or ban) are retained as part of that record.

Technical data: we process your IP address transiently to rate-limit login attempts and abusive report filing, and to enforce account bans. We do not sell or share this data with advertisers, and we do not run third-party trackers or analytics in the game client.

Guest play: if you play as a guest without registering, we do not create an account or store any of the above beyond the lifetime of your connection to a game room.

BROWSER STORAGE

The game client stores a small amount of data in your browser's local storage: your sign-in token (so you stay signed in), a reconnection token (so a dropped connection can rejoin your seat), and your audio/graphics preferences. None of this is used for tracking or advertising, and none of it is shared with third parties. See our cookie/storage notice for details.

RETENTION

Account data is kept for as long as your account exists. Raw chat logs are deleted after 30 days; a report's own evidence snapshot is kept until the report is resolved and for a reasonable period afterward for moderation accountability. Ban records are kept to enforce bans consistently.

YOUR RIGHTS

Under data protection laws such as the GDPR (EU) and KVKK (Türkiye), you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data, and to withdraw consent at any time. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from the Profile screen's "Delete Account" option. If you need help exercising any of these rights, contact us at the address below.

CHILDREN

Foghaven is not directed at children under 13, and registration requires confirming you meet this minimum age.

CHANGES

We may update this policy from time to time; the "Last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.

CONTACT

Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to privacy@foghaven.example (replace with your real support address before launch).

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
These Terms of Service govern your use of Foghaven. By registering an account, playing as a guest, or otherwise using the game, you agree to these terms.

ELIGIBILITY

You must be at least 13 years old to use Foghaven. By registering, you confirm you meet this requirement.

ACCOUNTS

You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity on your account. Usernames must not impersonate others, contain profanity, or otherwise violate the conduct rules below — we may reject or rename a username that does.

CONDUCT

While playing, you agree not to: harass or bully other players; use hate speech or slurs; spam or flood chat; cheat or exploit bugs to gain an unfair advantage; use an inappropriate username; grief teammates or deliberately throw games; or otherwise disrupt other players' experience. Players can report violations in-game; reports are reviewed by moderators.

MODERATION AND ENFORCEMENT

Violating these rules may result in a temporary mute, a temporary ban, or a permanent ban at our moderators' discretion, depending on severity and history. Ban reasons and duration (if temporary) are recorded and, where practical, shown to the affected account. We may act on reports, direct observation, or automated abuse detection (e.g. chat filtering, spam limits).

VIRTUAL CURRENCY AND COSMETICS

Coins are earned only by playing rounds and cannot currently be purchased with real money. Cosmetic items are purely decorative and never affect gameplay. We may adjust the cosmetics catalog, including prices, at any time; existing ownership of an item you already hold is not revoked by such a change.

GUEST PLAY

Playing as a guest does not create an account; guests can join existing rooms but not create them, and have no persistent stats, cosmetics, or ban-proof identity.

TERMINATION

You may delete your account at any time (see our Privacy Policy). We may suspend or terminate an account for violating these terms, including a permanent ban for serious or repeated violations.

DISCLAIMER AND LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Foghaven is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the game.

CHANGES

We may update these terms from time to time; continued use after a change constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

CONTACT

Questions about these terms can be sent to support@foghaven.example (replace with your real support address before launch).
